rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal cooling-fan run-on and, after the customer said it stops on its own within a few minutes, confirmed this points to normal operation without suggesting parts or repairs. It did not ask whether the run-on is longer after grill/convection or whether the fan runs when cold, and it did not mention warranty contact if it ran constantly. The second reply repeated the vent-check request almost verbatim and offered a vague 'restricted airflow' cause that is not really supported by the evidence, though it is harmless.
